title: Nail problems
claims: Toenails can take up to 18 months to grow back after an injury.
Trim nails regularly, straight across the top, and do not cut down the edges.
Do not clean under nails with sharp objects.
Do not wear shoes that pinch the toes, especially when exercising.
See a GP if a nail has changed shape, changed colour or fallen off and you do not know why.
Sore, red, swollen and warm skin around the nails (paronychia) can be a sign of infection or an ingrown toenail.
Nail problems can be a symptom of a more serious or long-term condition, including diabetes.
Cut injured, loose nails back to where they are still attached so they do not bend or catch on objects.
